name: Wörth am Main (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wörth am Main (quartered with crown, wheel and crosses).
history: Municipal flag of Wörth am Main; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wörth am Main arms — quartered with crown and wheel
